# U84: New goal in the order people think: what, then who and where (Tunde as owner, his team, Team level, his team’s SVP goals suggested for “Feeds into”, one chosen by typing, “Also helps” set), then how it’s measured, then Check reads it all back; each step is an address, the browser’s Back steps back with the numbers kept, a reload stays put and says the draft was picked up, and no select lists people, teams or goals

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `NEW-GOAL-STEPS`, `FIND-AND-PICK`
- **Budget:** at most 16 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `logged` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Tunde, at `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 5883

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Tunde (`tunde`).
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/what”.
- **Check:** “What do you want to achieve?” is shown.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- _Note:_ Continue with no name stays on step 1 and says why.
- Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert showing “name” is visible and the address matches “/goals/new/what” (else: an empty name is not explained, or the step moved on).
- **Step.** Type “Release notes drafted automatically” into the “Name it the way” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/who”.
- **Check:** “Whose is it, and where does it fit?” is shown.
- **Check:** (`entry`) it fails if the owner, team and level don’t start as Tunde, Build & Release and Team.
- _Note:_ Before typing, "Feeds into" suggests his team's SVP goals.
- **Step.** Press the “Feeds into” button.
- **Check:** An option in the open find-and-pick list (number 2) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if “Feeds into” doesn’t suggest Build & Release’s SVP goals first: {offered.slice(0, 4).join(' | ')}.
- **Step.** Type “feature flag” into a search field in the open find-and-pick list.
- **Check:** The “Releases behind a feature flag” option in the open find-and-pick list shows.
- Press the Enter key.
- Find and pick: press “Also helps”, type “merge-to-deploy”, and choose “Merge-to-deploy time”.
- Press the “Done” button in the open find-and-pick list.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “who and where”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Step.** Type “%” into the “Unit” field.
- **Step.** Type “10” into the “Baseline” field.
- **Step.** Type “80” into the “Target” field.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “measure”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- **Check:** “Does this read right?” is shown.
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if Check doesn’t read it all back: {read.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')}.
- _Note:_ The browser's Back returns to step 3 with the numbers kept; a reload stays there and says the draft was picked up.
- Press the browser’s Back.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- Reload the page.
- **Check:** “Picked up the goal you hadn’t published.” is shown (else: a reload does not say the draft was picked up).
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if Back or a reload lost the step or its numbers.
- _Note:_ Close and keep the draft; New goal picks it up at the same step.
- Press the “Close and keep the draft” button.
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- _Note:_ A Change from Check that makes a later step wrong: Continue goes to that step and says so (build review of #129).
- Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- Press the “Change what” button.
- Press the “Hit dated stages” button.
- Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if Continue after changing the type stayed on {p.url()} without saying what the stages step needs.
- _Note:_ No select anywhere on the steps lists people, teams or goals.
- **Check:** (`a11y`) it fails if a select lists {big} options.
- Close this browser.
